artworks.title: Fanciful Flowers and Bugs
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a central branch with stylized flowers and leaves, accompanied by several insects, including a large moth and smaller bugs. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with black and white tones, accented by light hints of beige or pink. In the upper part of the image, the branch curves diagonally from the top left to the bottom right, adorned with flowers positioned towards the top center and lower left. The large moth is seen in the upper right corner, while smaller branch structures with round buds and intricate leaf patterns are distributed around the lower and right portions. A small insect appears near the bottom center. The background of the image is light, making the complex lines and textures stand out.

artworks.title: Sir Peter Lely
artworks.artist: Isaak Beckett after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person. The individual is positioned slightly turned to the left with a gaze directed towards the viewer. Their facial features include a prominent nose, slightly pursed mouth, delicate eyes, and long, curly hair cascading down to the shoulders. The person is wearing a dark cloak over a white shirt visible at the neckline. No visible jewelry or objects are held. The background is a dark, neutral tone, and there is a decorative inscription in cursive style at the bottom on a light-colored panel.

artworks.title: Three Putti with a Dead Bull
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and punch engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a humanoid creature with the head of a bull, surrounded by two winged cherubs. The central figure has a muscular human body with the head of a bull. On either side, there are cherubic creatures with human bodies and wings. The background includes trees and plants. The drawing captures elements of mythology and folklore with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: At the Gate (Am Thor)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate gate with trees in the background. The scene features an elaborate wrought iron gate adorned with decorative motifs and topped with a lantern. Behind the gate, lush foliage is visible, casting shadows and creating a sense of depth. The gate is flanked by stone walls with iron railings continuing the intricate design. The setting suggests an entrance to a private garden or estate, with verdant trees visible in the distance. The entire scene is rendered in fine detail.

artworks.title: Disgrace (Schande): pl. 9
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of two women standing against a wall. Both women are upright, facing downward, with their arms crossed in front of them. The woman on the left has a shadow on the wall beside her and neatly combed hair pulled back. The woman on the right appears to have her hair covered, possibly with a headscarf. They wear long gowns with long sleeves and stand on a paved stone path. In the background is a curved wall with a darker area suggesting foliage or trees above it. Several additional figures appear to be watching from above the curved wall with detailed facial features. The setting is monochromatic.

artworks.title: In the Park (Im Park): pl.4
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a partially visible embrace. The man is leaning downward, the woman slightly tilted backward. The man has wavy hair, and the woman has dark hair pulled back. The man is in a suit, and the woman in a light-colored gown with ruffles. They are positioned on or near a curved stone balustrade. In the background, there are dense, textured trees.

artworks.title: Siesta I: pl.3
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of large crustaceans, possibly crabs, against a plain backdrop. The color scheme is grayscale, with shades of grey and off-white. The crabs are spread out on a textured surface, occupying most of the space in the composition.

artworks.title: Vue du Mont Blanc
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated position. The horizon is high, with distant mountains. In the foreground, there are rocks, sheep, and pine trees. A valley with trees and a town can be seen further back. The mountains dominate the scene, with varying textures suggesting rugged terrain. The sky is clear with a few clouds. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brown, showcasing the landscape's details with fine strokes capturing natural features.

artworks.title: Female Nude Seated
artworks.medium: drypoint on oatmeal paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated person facing right in a three-quarter profile. One arm is resting on the lap, while the other is behind the back. The facial features are simple, with hair pulled back. The person is minimalist with no clothes shown. There is no jewelry or objects. The background is plain with minimal details.

artworks.title: Narcissus [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is at the top of the drawing, with mountains in the distance. The ink lines depict detailed trees and foliage with light shading for depth. The color scheme is monochrome, using parchment paper color and black ink. In the foreground, various trees lead to the distant mountains.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with undulating hills receding into the distance from an elevated perspective. The horizon is shown in the middle of the drawing, with softly drawn lines indicating distant hills and landforms. The delicate style uses light pencil strokes to create a sketch-like appearance. The drawing features intricate contours and textures throughout. The color scheme includes beige paper with gray pencil for contrast. A hill or ridge is suggested on the right, leading the eye into the scene. Lines and scribbles in the distance represent the continuation of the landscape. The drawing seems to be an unfinished sketch, emphasizing the scene's foundational layout.

artworks.title: The Street Vendor (La Marchande ambulante)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black and brown on beige wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person seated at a table outdoors. The person has a serious expression with closed lips. They are dressed in a dark cloak and a garment with a collar, and their hair is covered by a hood or scarf. The person is holding a bowl and a utensil. On the table in front of them is a covered dish or container, and there is another jar or container to the side. The scene features a stark contrast between the dark lines of the figures and the lighter background on coarse paper. In the background, there is a simple depiction of a tent with figures in dark clothing nearby, as well as a building with closed windows and a door. Smaller figures behind the tent add depth to the scene, which is set in a public square or similar open space.

artworks.title: La Liseuse couchée
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray-green on beige wove paper
artworks.description: In the image, a woman is lying on her stomach with her body slightly angled to the side. Her head is resting on her hand as she appears to be reading a book. She has an updo with bangs partially covering her forehead and is wearing a flowing garment. Surrounding her are organic and swirling designs, including a plant in a pot and a small animal nearby. A framed geometric window pattern in the background adds structure to the scene. The image is dominated by earthy tones and is composed in a decorative style.

artworks.title: La Liseuse sous la lampe
artworks.medium: color lithograph on beige wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with one hand on their chin and the other arm behind a large lampshade. The person's face is partially turned away and obscured by the lamp. They have long, wavy hair and are wearing a dark top. A light-colored hat is placed on the table in front of them, next to the lamp's base. The background is simple and dark, creating contrast with the foreground.

artworks.title: Bretonnes sur le quai
artworks.medium: lithograph on beige wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of women outdoors. The women are shown from the waist up, standing side-by-side. They are facing the viewer, with their heads slightly turned towards each other. Their facial features are delicately sketched, giving them a composed expression. They all have head coverings and are dressed in traditional attire, including long dresses and shawls. One woman has a hand-stitched pattern on her shawl. There are small decorative elements on their clothing. The background includes outlines of buildings and a fence, contributing to the rustic atmosphere of the sketch.

artworks.title: Paysanne avec pannier
artworks.medium: lithograph in yellow and blue on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking to the right while carrying a large basket. They are depicted in profile with a slight forward bend, wearing a long dress with an apron and a head covering. The person's face is not clearly visible. The background is textured with light and dark shades. The image is rendered in monochrome on a light paper background.

artworks.title: Winged Horse (Cheval aile)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper mounted on wove paper

artworks.title: Susurrements, poèsies par Hébert-Milnard
artworks.medium: photomechanical reproduction (of a woodcut) with hand coloring on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person standing next to a tree in a village setting. The person has long dark hair, wearing a hat with a yellow band, a long skirt with a blue polka dot pattern, and a long-sleeved orange striped top. They are holding an umbrella. The background features buildings and hills, with a church in the distance. The image is created with bold lines and flat areas of color in yellow, blue, and orange, with integrated text.

artworks.title: Long Live the Tzar! (Vive le Tzar!)
artworks.medium: etching on wove cream paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a large rooster in a dynamic pose with fluffed feathers. The rooster is detailed, emphasizing its textured feathers and muscular legs and feet. It stands confidently with its beak open. Above the rooster, the text "VIVE LE TSAR!" is inscribed. The black-and-white sketch uses cross-hatching for a dramatic light and shadow effect, adding depth and intensity to the rooster's presence. The drawing captures the strong and proud essence of the rooster, imbuing it with regal qualities amidst the finely detailed background.

artworks.title: Burial in Brittany (L'Enterrement en Bretagne)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on white wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a room with several individuals wearing hooded cloaks. They are seated around tables, with one main figure in the foreground. Their faces are shadowed by the hoods, but one individual's face is partially visible beneath the hood. The figures appear somber and contemplative. The background is indistinct with shadows, giving a sense of a somber, enclosed indoor setting.

artworks.title: Breton Bathers (Baigneuses bretonnes)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) on Japan paper

artworks.title: Study for "The Fishermen" with Men Emptying the Nets (Etude pour "Les Pêcheurs" et hommes vidant des raies)
artworks.medium: charcoal
artworks.description: The image features a boat with figures on it, viewed from above. The figures are minimally sketched, with one standing and pointing outward. The sketch shows waves around the boat and vague figures on land. It is monochrome, with light background and dark pencil strokes, emphasizing line and shape.

artworks.title: Paul Sérusier
artworks.medium: charcoal on gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows two charcoal sketches of the same person from the side, focusing on their upper torso and head. The person is seated with their head slightly lowered, facing left in both sketches. They have long hair covering the ears and falling to the nape of the neck, along with a full beard and mustache. Their facial features include a prominent nose and a long, straight hairline. The person appears to be wearing a jacket in the top sketch, but it is not clearly defined. The background is plain and muted, with no objects or jewelry visible.

artworks.title: Normandy (La Normandie)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown and chine collé on laid cream paper
